name: Buffet Hot Breakfast Meats, Crispy Hash Browns & Chicken Sausage
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Poultry sausage links and blotted crispy bacon or potato hash browns work in remission, though frying oil and pork fat require moderation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the lean grilled chicken/turkey sausage or blot crispy bacon with a napkin; during a flare, swap fried hash browns for plain white rice or oatmeal.
watchOuts: Deep-fried oil in hash brown triangles
Pork sausage casings and rendered grease
Skip grilled tomatoes and baked beans
